proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public OGC citation exports
proposals.summary: OgcCitationController .bib / .ris / .jsonld are @Public with only the global 300/min ThrottlerGuard. Anonymous crawlers can hammer bibliography exports for every public item id. Add @Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 60 } }) on all three methods matching Records / OGC Features items.
proposals.rationale: Standing Low follow-up called out in R12 sentinel notes. Same Public catalogue class without a product call.
proposals.risk: Legitimate citation managers that batch-download may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; document in CHANGELOG Security + cite-an-item / api.md rate note. Keep formats and ACL unchanged.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardenings without waiting on pricing or Keycloak defaults.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on bib/ris/jsonld; CHANGELOG Security + cite-an-item note; fold a short Public Rate limits subsection into api.md covering citation plus already-shipped Records/Features/STAC/features-page/drawings/comments 60/min limits; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public OGC Features collection landing
proposals.summary: OgcFeaturesController GET / (collections list) and GET :id (collection landing) are @Public with only the global 300/min guard while items routes are already 60/min. Collections landing scans every public data_layer. Add @Throttle 60/min on both methods so scrapers cannot bypass the items throttle via catalogue fan-out.
proposals.rationale: Complement to SEC-ogc-features-throttle (#433). Landing is the cheap discovery path into the heavier items scans.
proposals.risk: MetaSearch / OWSLib clients that refresh catalogues often may hit 60/min. Prefer 60 to match Records; document in CHANGELOG Security. Leave tiles/styles byte routes alone.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardenings without inventing a new public tier.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on collections / and :id; CHANGELOG Security note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public features + geojson mirrors
proposals.summary: PublicController layerFeatures and layerGeojson remain @Public with only the global 300/min guard after features-page/search got 60/min (#444). The non-paged path streams a whole public layer FeatureCollection; the entity= path feeds anonymous popups. Add @Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 60 } }) on both methods; leave MVT tiles unchanged.
proposals.rationale: Heaviest remaining Public DoS class after features-page. Same Nest rate pattern as Records/Features items without lowering the stream ACL/geo clip.
proposals.risk: Busy public maps with many popup entity lookups may hit 60/min on shared NAT. Prefer 60 to match features-page; document in CHANGELOG Security. Do not Nest-throttle MVT.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardenings without inventing a new public tier.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on /features + /geojson; CHANGELOG Security note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public layer aggregate

proposals.risk: Public apps that auto-refresh charts may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; document in CHANGELOG Security. Do not change aggregate query dialect in the same PR.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardenings without waiting on abuse product calls.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on aggregate; CHANGELOG Security note; skip What's new.
